# docker_stack

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

A Swarm stack built from API primitives (not a compose file, no CLI): services, overlay networks, secrets and configs, each named `<stack>_<name>` and labelled `com.docker.stack.namespace=<stack>` so `docker stack ls/ps` show them. Requires the provider to point at a Swarm manager. Apply creates networks, secrets and configs first, then services, whose `networks`/`secrets`/`configs` references may use the short names of the stack's own objects. Updates diff the stack's labelled objects against the configuration: missing objects are created, services are updated in place (recreated when `mode` switches type), changed secrets/configs/networks are replaced after removing the services that use them, and objects no longer configured are removed. Destroy removes services first (waiting for their tasks to go), then secrets, configs and networks.

| `mode` | `number` | optional, computed |  |  | File mode as a decimal number (default `292`, i.e. `0444`). |
| `uid` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | File owner UID (default `0`). |

### `service.converge_config`

single block. When present, create and update wait until the service has converged: the wanted number of tasks running (every desired task for `global`) and no update paused or rolling back; for `replicated_job`, `total_completions` tasks completed; for `global_job`, every task of the current run finished with at least one completed. On timeout the apply fails with the task errors. Not sent to the daemon.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delay` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Poll interval (Go duration, default `5s`). |
| `timeout` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Maximum wait (Go duration, default `3m`). |

| `search` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | DNS search domains. |

### `volume`

list of blocks. A named volume `<stack>_<name>`. Swarm cannot pre-create volumes across nodes, so nothing is created up front: every service mount of `type = "volume"` whose `source` is this short name is rewritten to `<stack>_<name>` with this driver, options and labels, and each node's daemon creates the volume when a task first uses it. Volumes are not removed on destroy (like `docker stack rm`).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `driver` | `string` | optional |  |  | Volume driver (daemon default `local`). |
| `driver_opts` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Driver options. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Volume labels. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | Short name inside the stack. |

## Example

```terraform
# Every object is created as "shop_<name>" and labelled
# com.docker.stack.namespace=shop, so `docker stack ps shop` shows it.
resource "docker_stack" "shop" {
  name = "shop"

  network {
    name       = "backend"
    attachable = true
  }

  # Not pre-created: tasks create "shop_pgdata" on their node on first use.
  volume {
    name   = "pgdata"
    driver = "local"
  }

  secret {
    name = "db_password"
    data = base64encode("change-me")
  }

  config {
    name = "nginx"
    data = base64encode("server { listen 80; location / { proxy_pass http://api:8080; } }")
  }

  service {
    name     = "db"
    image    = "postgres:16-alpine"
    networks = { backend = {} } # stack-local short name

    env = {
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE = "/run/secrets/db_password"
    }

    mounts {
      type   = "volume"
      source = "pgdata" # stack volume short name
      target = "/var/lib/postgresql/data"
    }

    secrets {
      secret_id = "db_password" # stack secret short name
    }

    placement {
      constraints = ["node.role==manager"]
    }
  }

  service {
    name     = "web"
    image    = "nginx:1.27-alpine"
    replicas = 2
    networks = { backend = {} }

    configs {
      config_id = "nginx"
      file_name = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf"
    }

    endpoint_spec {
      ports {
        target_port    = 80
        published_port = 80
      }
    }

    converge_config {}
  }
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Import by stack name (the com.docker.stack.namespace label value). Secret
# data cannot be read back and volume blocks are not daemon objects, so add
# them to the configuration; the next apply replaces secrets once.
terraform import docker_stack.shop shop
```
